title: Deep-learning control links single-cell expression to growth responses
summary: A learned predictive controller enabled high-throughput measurements linking gene-expression patterns with functional outcomes in individual engineered bacterial cells. The study exposed heterogeneous growth responses under antibiotic challenge. The original result was public in the October 2022 preprint and later appeared in a 2024 journal article. This is a laboratory model-system study, not a clinical resistance result or validated intervention.

evidence.tested: Researchers measured single-cell expression and growth behavior under controlled comparisons.
evidence.unknown: Generalization beyond the engineered system and correspondence of every quantitative journal endpoint to v1 were not established.
evidence.ai_role: LSTM encoder-decoder predictive control supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Primary bioRxiv API v1 metadata/abstract; journal PMC abstract and selected model Methods and functional Results. No v1 quantitative endpoints transferred.
